plugins.name: bootgs
plugins.description: Skills for building Google Apps Script backends with the bootgs framework: project bootstrap, layered architecture enforcement, parameter validation, client/Virtual Transport Layer, and OpenAPI generation.

plugins.name: apps-script
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic Google Apps Script skills — triggers, built-in services, UI (menus/sidebars/dialogs), the clasp CLI workflow, the apps-script-utils guard/utility library, and Marketplace publishing/compliance. Usable without bootgs; apps-script-utils also pairs naturally with it.
